run_cfr_solver: run the CFR solver on Kuhn Poker with configurable iterations and solver type via CLI flags
create_cfrplus_solver: create a CFRPlus solver instance for a specified game and number of players
create_cfrbr_solver: create a CFRBR solver instance for a specified game and number of players
test_exploitability: test the exploitability of a solver's average policy on a game using pyspiel.exploitability
summarize_pickle_persist: summarize how to persist and reload a CFR solver using pickle serialization
